text: {"decision": "reject", "reason": "sets.mcmIdExtras is a Cardmarket (MCM) set ID (its sibling columns mcmId/mcmName confirm this), while cards.id is a dense internal surrogate key spanning 1–56832, so any 4-digit integer like 2371–3680 is contained by chance, making the 10-value overlap coincidental rather than a real reference (the semantically related target would be cards.mcmMetaId, not cards.id)."}
